page.summary_en: KYC, or know your customer, is the identity check regulated exchanges must perform under anti-money-laundering rules. No regulated platform can skip it. Most failures come from a few causes: expired or unsupported ID, blurry or incomplete photos, entered details that do not match the ID, screenshots or photocopies, and failed face verification. If you are rejected, read the exact reason, fix that item, and submit again. Only submit ID inside the official app or website, never to “support” in private messages.
checklist_en: My ID is mine and still valid
I am at least 18 years old
I photographed the original document, not a screenshot or photocopy
The photo is clear, complete, and has no glare
The name and birthday I entered match the ID
I submit only through the official app or website

quiz_en.q: Why do regulated exchanges require KYC?
options: It can be skipped and does not matter
quiz_en.why: KYC comes from international anti-money-laundering standards, and regulated platforms must follow them.

quiz_en.q: Which upload is likely to be rejected?
options: Uploading a screenshot of the ID
Taking the photo in good light
quiz_en.answer: Uploading a screenshot of the ID
quiz_en.why: OKX help materials state that screenshots and photocopies are usually not accepted.

quiz_en.q: After KYC is rejected, what is the best next step?
options: Read the reason and fix only that item before resubmitting
Submit the same documents again and again
Send your ID to support in a private message
quiz_en.answer: Read the reason and fix only that item before resubmitting
quiz_en.why: Submitting the same material repeatedly will not solve the issue, and private-message requests for ID photos are a common scam.

faq_en.q: What should I do if KYC fails?
faq_en.a: Check the exact reason on the verification page or in the registration email. Common causes include expired ID, unclear photos, inconsistent details, screenshots, and failed face verification. Fix the issue and submit again.

faq_en.q: Is it safe to give an exchange my ID?
faq_en.a: KYC is a regulatory requirement. Submit documents only through the official app or website and confirm the domain is correct. Do not send ID photos to anyone who contacts you privately.
We only explain regulated flows. Regulated exchanges require identity verification, and NexuAlpha does not provide ways to bypass real-name checks.
